name: Santiponce (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Santiponce (a mitre and a tree on white and green).
history: Municipal flag of Santiponce; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Santiponce arms — mitre and tree on white and green
